requirements.text: A minimum of three years of software engineering experience building products, platforms, or internal tools that improve business operations or team productivity
Solid backend fundamentals, paired with a genuine desire to be a generalist — comfortable moving into frontend, data, or infrastructure work whenever the problem calls for it
A track record of learning quickly and expanding into unfamiliar areas; we’re hiring for trajectory and adaptability at least as much as for what you already know

A builder’s mindset and strong product instincts — someone who sees themselves as a product engineer, wants to understand what neighbors and operators actually need, and treats technology as a means to that end

Genuine, hands-on AI-nativeness: fluency with tools like Claude Code and Cursor, a clear point of view on when AI speeds you up and when it doesn’t, and the judgment to keep quality high while moving fast
Experience working closely with business and product stakeholders to solve real workflow problems through software
Strong hands-on skills (or a desire to learn) shell scripting, Python, Go, TypeScript, and more
Experience working with a range of data and retrieval patterns, including relational systems, vector databases, and graph databases
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable writing clear documentation, effective AI prompts, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
A solid understanding of the principles and challenges of building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software systems
The ability to balance elegant design with practical tradeoffs while prioritizing continuous delivery of value to the business
Experience building in fast-moving startup environments
Strong analytical skills, curiosity, and a bias toward action
A deep interest in how AI can reshape products, workflows, and the way teams operate, along with a desire to ship tools that create measurable impact in real physical environments
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship.
Finally, we believe our team is better together. Every position at Flow has an onsite or in-office requirement.
